independent_test.reason: The entire existing video and NGSIM reference have already informed development. These windows are retrospective diagnostics, not an unseen test.

notes: Gates are engineering targets, not demonstrated improvements or field-safety guarantees.
Candidate gates must be checked on paired seeds and identical scheduled demand, including unfinished and uninserted vehicles.
Changing a threshold requires a recorded reason before examining the final comparison.
Existing calibration and signal estimates use the whole video; slicing metrics does not refit those components or remove leakage.
